description: Fix the off-by-one in the csvlite row splitter: the trailing field is dropped whenever it is empty, so exports ending on a separator come back one field short and misalign the billing batch; the hidden gate replays the corrupted export while quoting behaviour and the visible tests must stay green.

criteria: csvlite.py returns every field of a row including trailing empty ones ('a,b,' is ['a', 'b', ''], a row of only separators is all empty fields, an empty row is one empty field), keeps quoting and doubled-quote escapes intact, and parse/pad_row line up with the header again - without touching the gate, the visible tests or the README.
